svg.title: Halden 1 — Condenser & pump deck
svg.desc: Illustrative PWR conventional-island architectural arrangement with a turbine hall and adjacent feedwater-pump room. Heavy walls = cut; fine solid = equipment; dashed = above / below as labelled. Amber hatch = outage space; green = access. All physical dimensions are authored assumptions. Existing simulation component identities are retained.
